qsm-statusline render.description: Read the harness status-line payload on stdin and print the status line; a source that is unavailable is omitted, and the render always succeeds

args.name: cwd
args.description: directory whose git state to show (defaults to the payload's working directory)

qsm-statusline refresh.description: Recompute one directory's cached git state; the renderer starts this behind the frame, and it is runnable by hand to warm a cold cache

args.name: cwd
args.description: directory to read (defaults to the working directory)

qsm-statusline doctor.description: Report whether the binary is on PATH and whether the harness settings run it, and print the status-line entry that wires it

args.name: settings
args.description: settings file to read (defaults to the user's Claude Code settings.json)
